identity.name: mintbot-mcp
identity.description: An MCP server on the agent's own VPS: chat with the agent and manage every mintbot setting (model, persona, name, credit, jobs, extensions, Telegram bot, updates, SSH keys, two-factor) from any MCP client such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor. No central server involved; loopback only, bearer-authenticated.
identity.author: mintbot.ai

services.name: mcp
services.summary: Streamable-HTTP MCP server on loopback (bearer-authenticated): chat with the agent and read or change every mintbot setting.

reason.network_egress: install.sh pip-installs the pinned dependencies (mcp, httpx, uvicorn, pyyaml) into a private virtualenv under the install prefix (PyPI); at runtime only the display name, the credit balance and the model catalog are read from the mintbot API, exactly as the agent's own tools do.
reason.network_ingress: The MCP endpoint itself: HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8650, never on a public interface, every request except /health must carry the bearer token created at install.
reason.filesystem: config:r = the Hermes home is read for the API server key and the mintbot block of config.yaml (agent id, panel token); state:rw = the bearer token (mode 0600) lives in the extension state dir. Settings are changed through the panel-local daemon on loopback, never by editing files.
reason.runtime: Chat turns go to the Hermes API server on loopback and run as the agent's own turns (same model, same credit); the daemon holds no LLM credentials of its own.
